name: Empire State Winter Whirl 2023
information: This is a series competition with [Empire State Winter Warmup 2023](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EmpireStateWinterWarmup2023), which will have a more traditional competition experience. We highly recommend that newer competitors and/or competitors who only want to compete in a few events register for that one instead. You may only register for and compete in one of the two competitions. If you have already registered (with payment) for Empire State Winter Warmup 2023, your registration for this competition will be rejected. All competitors must read the COVID Safety tab before registering, as proof of full vaccination or a negative test will be required.
